name: Country Club
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5; Weight 3 lbs.; Price 18,300 gp

DESCRIPTION

This +1 club is fashioned from local hardwood and engraved with symbols of nature and animal lore. Creatures with the animal type suffer an additional 1d6 damage when struck with this weapon. The wielder of a country club also gains a +4 bonus to all Survival skill checks and Handle Animal checks. Once per day the wielder may also use the club to simulate the druid’s wild empathy ability.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Spells speak with animals; Cost 9,150 gp
